text:
sarah: Quick follow-up on the ingress pressure hints + resumable-trailer contract. I sketched a lightweight proposal to give callers a non-intrusive signal about queue pressure, a sampled telemetry plan, and an optional resume-trailer flow for routes that opt into resumable outputs. High level: compact header for realtime signals, metric histograms for load trends, and an opt-in `Edge-Resume` trailer for checkpointing.

alex: Sounds promising. Two quick concerns: 1) perf impact of adding a header at the hot dispatch path, 2) multi-tenant info leakage.

sarah: For perf: header built from an atomic queue depth sample at dispatch (no allocation unless logging). We'll gate header emission with `edge.backpressure_headers.enabled` and per-route `route.backpressure.visibility`. For leakage: header only contains numeric fields (level, q-depth, window id), no tenant id. Example: `X-Edge-Pressure: lvl=2;q=48;win=7`.

jamie: How should clients interpret lvl? Is this advisory or authoritative (i.e. will we ever reject based on it)?

sarah: Proposal: semantic mapping: lvl=0 healthy (no hint). lvl=1 advisory (suggest batching/longer timeout). lvl=2 constrained (prefer client-side retry with exponential backoff). lvl=3 shedding (gateway may reject non-priority work). We also document SDK defaults so clients don't panic on lvl=1.

mike: For streaming, if ingress decides to preempt mid-stream, how does resume work? Trailers can be messy with streaming protocols. Billing and idempotency are tricky too.

sarah: Trailers are gated per-route. If enabled, when we checkpoint we emit `Edge-Resume` trailer like: `Edge-Resume: token=sha256:abc...;offset=1536;lvl=3;exp=170`. Tokens include model-version hash and window id. Contract: resumed requests are billed from the resume offset forward; we persist minimal checkpoint meta for 5 minutes.

alex: Billing contract ok but need to be explicit about model rollovers invalidating tokens. Also token entropy and single-use vs multi-use?

sarah: Tokens include model-version digest; on model deploy we invalidate tokens for older versions. Default expiry 5 minutes. Single-use optional: route config `resume.single_use=true` can enforce single-use nonces for higher-sensitivity routes.

jamie: Observability plan? I want heatmaps and sampled traces without creating an explosion of traces.

sarah: Metrics: aggregate histograms for queue depth and admit latency scraped every 10s. Tracing: sample at admit time when lvl>=2 or when a resume trailer is emitted. Tag traces with `pressure_lvl` and `admit_snapshot`. Dashboards: "Ingress pressure heatmap" and per-route histogram. Alerts: sustained lvl>=2 for >60s triggers paging.

mike: Retry storms risk when many clients retry on 5xx/429. Can we include backoff hints in responses?

sarah: Soft-first approach: header is advisory. But if we need to enforce, respond 429 + `Retry-After`. Also include `Edge-Backoff: base=250;jitter=0.25;mode=exp` as a hint for respectful clients.

alex: Need bench numbers. Also allow dedicated/private customers to opt-out of headers for compliance.

sarah: Bench plan: microbench hot dispatch with header enabled vs disabled measuring p50/p99 and CPU. Feature flags: global `edge.backpressure_headers.enabled` and per-route/tenant `route.backpressure.visibility`. Dedicated clusters can set `edge.backpressure_headers.enabled=false`.

jamie: Sampling bias: sample at admit-time (not completion) to avoid bias toward long-lived requests. Also include admit-bucket so we can relate queue depth to outcome.

sarah: Agreed. We'll sample at admit and tag with admit_bucket and pressure_lvl.

ops-bot: RFC-1367-apply: edge-pressure-hints staged to edge-canary-2. Canary window: 02:00 UTC, 10% traffic.

mike: One more: define resume-token format and size limits (we shouldn't bloat trailers). Also define checksum so clients can validate.

sarah: Token rules: 48-64 bytes (base64url), contains model-version prefix, window id, and HMAC-sig. Include short expiry (5m) and optional single-use nonce. We'll publish token spec in the RFC doc.

alex: Actionable next steps: sarah to push spec with header schema, trailer schema, sampling rules, and feature flags. I'll take microbench. Jamie will draft dashboard/alert panels. Mike will review trailer token HMAC/entropy.

sarah: On it 9 I'll open an RFC branch and drop a minimal API + k8s flag patch in the repo tonight. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

jamie: Add note for SDKs: treat lvl=1 as "hint" and implement incremental backoff only from lvl>=2.

sarah: Good call, will include recommended SDK defaults.

ops-bot: canary started for edge-canary-2 at 02:00 UTC 9 10% traffic.
